Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Quality & Construction: The seller shall supply brand-new, heavy-duty portable mobile toilets made o f good-quality FRP material, with a sturdy MS structural frame, anti-skid flooring and weather-resistant con struction. All units shall be free from manufacturing defects, cracks, leakage and damage. 2. Complete Accessories & Facilities: Each toilet shall be supplied with all necessary fittings and acces sories, including WC, wash basin, 300-litre overhead water tank, 200-litre sludge tank, taps, plumbing con nections, ventilation, solar lighting, exhaust fan, lifting hooks, doors, locks and other essential accessories. No components shall be charged separately. 3. Transportation, Installation & Commissioning: The seller shall be responsible for transportation, lo ading, unloading, placement, installation, plumbing, electrical/solar connections, testing and commissionin g of all three units at the consignee's location without any additional cost. 4. Warranty & Replacement: A minimum one-year warranty shall be provided from the date of successf ul installation and commissioning. Any defective, damaged, leaking or non-functional component identified during inspection or the warranty period shall be repaired or replaced by the seller free of cost. . 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 13. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 14. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
